mainEntity.name: What happens to our data if we stop paying?

acceptedAnswer.text: It stays yours. Export everything at any time, including after you have cancelled, in a plain readable format. We do not hold records to ransom and there is no charge for taking your own data out.

mainEntity.name: Does it work when the internet goes down?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for the daily work. Registers, marks, fee collection with expenses, and new admissions keep working with no connection, in the Android app, the Windows program, and a browser that has opened the software online before. A receipt printed offline is final: each phone or computer holds its own block of receipt numbers, so two devices can never print the same one. The work goes in when the connection returns, and a device can work offline for up to seven days at a time.

mainEntity.name: Can a clerk change a receipt after it is printed?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Nothing is deleted or edited. A mistake is corrected by a reversal entry, so both lines stay in the ledger with a reason and the name of the person who made the correction. Every receipt number is used once and recorded. A device working offline holds its own block of numbers, and every block, and any number in it left unused, is on record, so a missing number can always be accounted for.

mainEntity.name: Can parents see other children's information?

acceptedAnswer.text: A parent login reaches only that family's own children: their fee balance, their receipts, their attendance and their results once you publish them. It cannot reach any other family, and it cannot reach anything you have not published.

mainEntity.name: We already have years of records in Excel. Can we move them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Students, staff and opening balances import from a spreadsheet. Bring us the file you already keep and we will map it with you rather than asking you to retype a school.

mainEntity.name: What about results that are not final yet?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marks stay unpublished until you publish them, and a result card can be withheld for a single student, for example while a fee matter is settled. Parents see nothing until you decide they should.

mainEntity.name: Is there a manual, or do you train us?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. The handbook is sixteen chapters with real screenshots taken from the software itself, and it is free to read now, before you buy anything. It covers the office screens, the parent portal and what to do when something is entered wrong. We also walk your clerk through the first month's fee run on a call.

The screens are in English. Anything you type is accepted and printed in Urdu, including names, addresses and remarks, so a certificate or a fee receipt can carry Urdu text. A full Urdu interface is not built yet, and we would rather say so than imply otherwise.
